header_keys.values: trim; unwrap one matching pair of backticks, single quotes, or double quotes

recipient_header.alias_semantics: plural alias normalizes to canonical intended_recipient

created_at.datetime: must include Z or an explicit UTC offset
created_at.historical_projection_exception: may use immutable source commit time, with created_at_basis=source_commit_invalid_header

body.starts_after: header block and separating blank lines
body.conversation_closed_by_sender: last non-whitespace body line is exactly #ENDTHREAD

hashes.full_sha256: SHA-256 of exact original UTF-8 bytes
hashes.body_sha256: SHA-256 of exact parsed body UTF-8 bytes
